technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: Bosch ESP Fren Systems:
The Bosh 5.x ABS modules drop communication at road speeds which makes it difficult, if not impossible, to log live measuring block data. If the Fren Light Switch is suspected as faulty and causing a G201 fault:
Try logging the Engine or Transmission for Fren light switching.
Drive with the Cruise Control on and see if the system works as per design. If the CCS will not operate or the CCS does not shut off when the Frens are applied the Fren Light Switch may be faulty.
